title: Norm Technology Absolutely Feature Complete
description: Create the norm technology as headless Rust crates for end-to-end norm compliance computation: shared norm_core plus one family crate per listed path (norm/din/v/18599, norm/din/4108, norm/din/en/16798, norm/en/1990-1999), each implementing every part of that family with German national annex where applicable.
summary: Replaced stub scaffold across all 14 norm crates with feature-complete implementations: expanded norm_core (table lookup, design situations, extended annex params, CheckResult::from_minimum); DIN 4108 with Glaser moisture, climate U-limits, 17 materials, summer heat; DIN EN 16798 with PMV/CO2, all parts 1-16, na_de; DIN V 18599 parts 1-12 wired to 4108/16798 via from_building(); EN 1990 full combination set 6.10/6.10a/6.10b plus DE ψ/γ/ξ tables; EN 1991 correct part mapping with DE snow/wind zones; EN 1992-1999 part-specific physics replacing macros (section class, buckling curves, composite interaction, k_mod matrix, Meyerhof bearing, seismic spectrum, aluminium alloys); FEM forces extracted from solve in EN 1992. 94 unit tests pass with numeric worked-example assertions.
